newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy money mkt stable over next month.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy money mkt stable over next month.

text.p: Italy's money market sees the overnight rate on a one month horizon standing at 7.31 percent from 7.38 percent on Thursday, a study by the Bocconi University research arm Igier showed on Friday.
The study, which uses implicit forward rates and is based on Thursday's market rates, last week showed the implicit overnight rate over the same time period at 7.29 percent.

On a three month horizon, the implicit overnight rate is seen standing at 7.21 percent, slightly lower than the 7.26 percent seen a week ago and slightly higher than the 7.18 percent forecast one month ago.

On a one year horizon, the implicit overnight rate was seen at 7.12 percent, lower than the 7.26 percent seen a week ago and higher than the 6.88 percent seen one month ago. On a two year horizon, the implicit overnight rate was seen at 7.47 percent from 7.48 percent one week ago and 7.04 percent a month ago.

The spread between the Italian implicit overnight rate and the implicit German overnight rate, considered a good indicator of market confidence in Europe's economic and monetary union, was seen at 263 basis points from 267 basis points a week ago and 245 basis points one month ago.
